info.title: elevenlabs/eleven_v3
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "elevenlabs/eleven_v3", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Request body for ElevenLabs Text-to-Dialogue (multi-voice TTS). The `example` below is the COMFY ROUTER form and omits `model_id`, which Router fills from the `{model}` path segment; a direct v1 call to POST /proxy/elevenlabs/v1/text-to-dialogue may send it, and the route admits `eleven_v3`, `eleven_v4` and `eleven_v4_turbo`.

apply_text_normalization.description:
Controls text normalization with three modes:
'auto' - system automatically decides whether to apply text normalization
'on' - text normalization will always be applied
'off' - text normalization will be skipped

inputs.description:
A list of dialogue inputs, each containing text and a voice ID which will be converted into speech.
The maximum number of unique voice IDs is 10.

language_code.description:
Language code (ISO 639-1) used to enforce a language for the model and text normalization.
If the model does not support provided language code, an error will be returned.

model_id.description:
Identifier of the model that will be used. This route admits
'eleven_v3', 'eleven_v4' and 'eleven_v4_turbo' and nothing else;
any other value is rejected with 400 before the request reaches
ElevenLabs.
The upstream ElevenLabs advice to query GET /v1/models for the
available set does NOT describe this route, which serves only these
models.
It is NOT in this schema's `required` list because Comfy Router
fills it from the `{model}` path segment of
/v2/models/elevenlabs/{model}, so a Router caller omits it.

pronunciation_dictionary_locators.description:
A list of pronunciation dictionary locators (id, version_id) to be applied to the text.
They will be applied in order. You may have up to 3 locators per request.

seed.description:
If specified, our system will make a best effort to sample deterministically.
Repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.
Must be integer between 0 and 4294967295.

ElevenLabsDialogueInput.description: A single dialogue input containing text and voice ID

text.description: The text to be converted into speech.

voice_id.description: The ID of the voice to be used for the generation.

stability.description:
Determines how stable the voice is and the randomness between each generation.
Lower values introduce broader emotional range for the voice.
Higher values can result in a monotonous voice with limited emotion.

pronunciation_dictionary_id.description: The ID of the pronunciation dictionary

version_id.description: The version ID of the pronunciation dictionary
